CQC PASS9: native MG2 fighters, native star and sourced stage motion

Add the four reviewed MSX2 fighters to standalone CQC and the Shadow CQC tab, with native eight-pose star rendering and three reviewed stage updates. Preserve original generation attempts and the complete canonical catalogue losslessly.

Validation:413 integrated engine checks,705 Shadow tests,273 native browser checks,77 stage game checks, production build and PWA.
